title: Question Battle
description: A live class quiz played as a co-op boss battle: the whole class answers together to beat a silly boss (a grumpy storm cloud, a cheeky robot or a sleepy dragon). Every right answer fires a star, faster answers and streaks hit harder, and a top five with overtakes after each question. Played alone, it is a quick practice round against the boss.
notes: Oomba Live reference game (built-in mode 'battle'), 2D on the Oomba Kit 1.1.1 with the live pack. A co-op boss battle: the host picks one of three bosses at random and shares it with setState({boss}); every screen computes the boss's energy only from the reveals' answer counts (each question an equal share, 45-100% of it landing by the share of right answers; the last question always finishes the boss, so the class always wins). The server keeps all points; streak power-ups (fire stars, lightning, rainbow) are pictures only. Projector: the boss big, the question, animated answer bars, stars flying from the right tile, the top five with overtakes sliding and a star line, the defeat cutscene and podium. Phones: the boss small, chunky answer buttons, your own attack, a streak pill, vibration where allowed. Uses Oomba.live: ready({lobby, quiz, hostView, teams}), the question / answers / reveal / result / end / emote / state events, quiz.answer, setState and flat(). Test hooks: window.__brbTest.state() (with boss {kind, hp, mood} and streak), answer(i). Looks like the classroom dashboard's widgets, as Crossword (Nov 2026): a dotted mint board, the boss on its arena card (the boss's group color on the top edge, its icon chip, name and energy bar in the head; painted on the canvas so the boss can wobble and flash inside it; the bosses keep their drawings, with a soft spotlight in dark mode), the question in the dark Now bar, answer tiles with the answer bars grown across them on the projector, the top five, team board and podiums as widget cards, the lobby as small cards for everyone (one widget per team in team mode), light and dark from BRB.theme (else the device), Bricolage Grotesque. The kit and its live pack stay for the plumbing; nothing on the wire changed. Smoke tests: tests/unit/live-board-battle-look.test.js.
